Trimmed copies of the original dataset files, 30 questions each, in their original JSON format.
- `squad_30.json`: from SQuAD 2.0 dev (Rajpurkar, Jia, Liang 2018), CC BY-SA 4.0, https://rajpurkar.github.io/SQuAD-explorer/
- `hotpot_30.json`: the first 30 questions of HotpotQA dev distractor (Yang et al. 2018), CC BY-SA 4.0, https://hotpotqa.github.io/
